$description: Design tokens (ADR-0040). DTCG-shaped; scripts/generate-tokens.mjs emits src/tokens.css. `sports.outdoor` carries the high-contrast override for the tokens that change.

muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, meta lines, disabled words.

wash-faint.$description: The barely-there tint on a deck row still awaiting a result.

brand.$description: School accent. Default only — the server supplies the school's own (ADR-0040 §3).

brand-ink.$description: Text and rules on the brand fill; computed from the brand colour at runtime.

status-ink.$description: Text on a filled status colour (ok/warn/bad/info).

warn-deep.$description: Edge of an amber fill (banner underline).

bad-deep.$description: Edge of a red fill (banner underline, demo stripe).

dot-ok.$description: Outbox dot on the brand header — lightened to carry on a dark fill.

line-print.$description: Table rule in @media print, where the screen border disappears.

paper-clear.$description: --paper at zero alpha: the far end of a scroll-edge fade.

scroll-shade.$description: The shade at a table's scrollable edge. Default ink, fixed: outdoor must not darken it.

brand-ink-edge.$description: Outline of a chip on the brand fill. Resolves at :root, so --brand-ink must only ever be set there.

brand-ink-soft.$description: Secondary text on the brand fill.

space.$description: Padding, gaps and margins. The scale is 3xs to 2xl; every other member is off-scale legacy.

4xs.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

3xs-plus.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

2xs-plus.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

xs-plus.$description: Control padding and tight gaps. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

sm-plus.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

md-plus.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

lg-plus.$description: Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

demo-banner-y.$description: The demo banner's vertical padding. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

cell-y-wide.$description: Table cell padding from the tablet breakpoint. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

result-button-x.$description: Edit/Undo result buttons. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

badge-hit.$description: A badge-button's vertical hit-area outset (negative inset). Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

caption-drop.$description: A field caption's height: drops a control level with a labelled one. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

demo-reserve.$description: Bottom room the demo banner reserves (screen padding, toaster). Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

print-gap.$description: The program grid's gap on paper.

menu.$description: The one elevation: toasts, menus and popovers. Nothing else lifts.

banner-text.$description: Legibility on the striped demo banner; text only, lifts nothing.

ui.$description: Self-hosted variable Inter (ADR-0040 §4); the stack is the offline fallback.

size-root.$description: html font-size. Every other size is rem, so this scales the app.

tracking-tight.$description: em on purpose: resolves against the element using it. Never register with @property.

type.$description: Font sizes, relative to the 18px root.

time.$description: The deck's time field — read at arm's length.

md-plus.$description: Tablet tables, toasts, program stream names. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

dismiss.$description: The toast's dismiss glyph. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

badge-glyph.$description: A glyph inside a badge, relative to the badge's own size. Off-scale legacy: closed to new uses.

size.$description: Pinned measurements: targets, bars, columns, measures; named for the role.

add-button.$description: A row's Add, held so "Adding…" cannot resize the row (ADR-0059 §2).

attempt-slot.$description: One attempt cell's mark, and each of its buttons (ADR-0053 §6).

jump-athlete.$description: The card grid's sticky athlete column (ADR-0056 §4), narrow enough that a phone shows a whole group of three attempt boxes beside it.

tap-tall.$description: The deck's tall control: the time field, the mat's buttons.

row-tall.$description: An eligible-list row, tapped fast at arm's length.

header-chip.$description: Carnival chip on the brand header. Below the 44px rule: debt, not licence.

outbox-chip.$description: Outbox chip on the brand header. Below the 44px rule: debt, not licence.

dismiss.$description: Toast dismiss. Below the 44px rule: debt, not licence.

capture-row.$description: The capture column: field plus caption line, so a save moves nothing.

result.$description: A saved time in the row's result slot.

row-action.$description: The row's action slot, and Edit/Undo.

row-state.$description: The row's state slot: the longest state word.

compact-control.$description: An inline select or the outbox's narrow time box.

deck-bar-basis.$description: Flex basis of the deck's progress bar.

control-min.$description: Floor of a growing input, row button or menu.

text-min.$description: Floor of a sentence or card before it wraps.

identity-column.$description: The deck row's name column from the tablet breakpoint.

eligible-list.$description: Scrolled height of the eligible list.

header-max.$description: Cap on the header's identity and carnival chip.

bar-sliver.$description: A zero-score standings bar still shows.

shade-cell.$description: Fade width on the sticky age-band cell.

scroll-fade.$description: The paper fade hiding a shade at rest.

indicator.$description: The focus outline and the current nav tab's underline.

float.$description: The demo banner, menus and popovers.

quiet.$description: Secondary text on the brand fill; a chip's count.

breakpoint.$description: Written as literals in styles.css: @media cannot read var(). Emitted as a comment only.
